disposition_records.OWN-07: Vector384/512/768/1536Optimized hash(into:) feeds every SIMD4 storage block in order, then the fixed dimension (Q13 form). Float/SIMD Hashable semantics, so ±0 hash equally; no raw bits, no caching; equality, storage and I02 cache identity unchanged. Verified by OptimizedHashContractTests (interior-only sparse and dense corpora, late lanes, ±0 every block, real Set/Dictionary) and the structural check test_optimized_hash_coverage.py with mutation and shadow fixtures. One-host Release: distinct hashValues over the interior-only corpora 1 → 64/512/1024. Tradeoff, not a speed claim: O(D) uncached hashing, per-hash ≈16.6× (384) to ≈63.7× (1536) slower (BASE G → FINAL G medians); dictionary insert+lookup slower at corpus 64, faster at 512/1024. Process-seeded, collisions legal; ledger V04-C-0500 corrected.
disposition_records.API-23: For small k (min(k,n) < n/10), selection no longer materializes n distances or pairs on: TopKSelection.select (array), select<T>, nearest/batchNearest and VectorMath.nearestNeighbors (shared internal selectByScore, Int-indexed TopKBuffer, sort of retained entries only, no Int32 route or ceiling); generic small-k Operations.findNearest (one no-hint parallelReduce, per-range heaps of min(k′,|range|)); small-k BatchOperations.findNearest (generic feeds the heap directly; the six optimized routes use the unchanged BatchKernels range helpers on ≤256-candidate tiles, one heap per worker partition, ≤min(C,L) partitions). Verified by TopKSelectorOracleTests, the phase D differential (5,652 cases, 0 mismatches), the P01 Operations and Batch route suites, B10 parity (396,180 comparisons, 0 mismatches, Debug/Release/ASan/TSan) and P01DirectEuclideanAdmissionTests (squared admission on all 7 direct Euclidean routes; root-admission mutant: 192 issues). Release D4, one host: e.g. select.array N=262,144 k=8 24 events/12,566,576 B → 5/480; select.generic N=16,384 k=1 32,789/1,490,852 → 6/212; ops.generic.dyn64.sequential N=16,384 k=1 29/901,440 → 12/612. Retained and not credited: large-k O(n) paths by design; Operations cosine 768/1536 fused n-score route; the pre-existing 16·n+32 B handle-array conversion on optimized routes (routed to P02). No speedup or RSS claim.
disposition_records.API-45: VectorMath.nearestNeighbors uses the shared selector: ascending, numeric before NaN, smaller original index on exact ties (±0 and NaN pairs included), original bits; k ≤ 0 (negative included) and empty input return [] with no metric call; positive k makes exactly n calls in index order and returns min(k,n). Docs state small-k and large-k complexity separately; false heap/O(n log k)/Accelerate claims removed or qualified; CHANGELOG Breaking entry with migration. Verified by VectorMathNearestContractTests (k=0 zero calls; the negative-k child exits 0; [NaN,1,0] k=3 → [2,1,0]) and the VectorMath route of TopKSelectorOracleTests, Debug and Release. One-host Release vectormath.dim64 N=16,384 k=8: 32,791 events/3,129,920 B → 3/320 per call.

resource_model_B17: The temporary model for built-in small-k BatchOperations is O(C·k′ + C·256 + k′), excluding inputs and results. Measured on one host in Release (C = 16): per-call requested bytes on the optimized routes are a pre-existing 16·N+32 B handle-array conversion (outside the model; routed to P02) plus an N-independent remainder (serial exactly 1,220 B including one 1,056 B tile; parallel ≈50,964 B at N=4,096 and ≈51,732 B at N=16,384). Generic parallel totals 33,908 B (N=4,096) and 34,164 B (N=16,384). Against base: 332,900 → 116,532 B (optimized, N=4,096); 270,732 → 33,908 B (generic). Events rose at N ≤ 4,096 with default partitions and fell at N=16,384 and in min1 mode. C-dependence not measured. No allocation-free or constant-memory claim.
